scope: Multi-threaded BCn upload/decode/readback through the Vulkan wrapper on one device.

fixture.build: NDK r27d aarch64-linux-android34-clang -std=c11 -O2 -g -Wall -Wextra -Werror -D_GNU_SOURCE -ldl, 16 KB page-size link flags
fixture.design: N threads share one VkDevice; each owns a command pool, source/destination buffers and a BCn image. Per iteration: map source, upload, wrapper decode, readback, compare with a golden single-threaded iteration. Odd iterations keep the source mapped across the submit (application-mapped case for the host-CPU path); even iterations unmap first. Each iteration creates and destroys its command buffer and fence. Queue submission is serialised by a mutex (Vulkan external synchronisation); all other calls are concurrent.

limitations: Software Vulkan (lavapipe) on emulators; not an Adreno/Turnip result.
Queue submission is serialised by the fixture; concurrent submission to one queue is invalid Vulkan usage and was not tested.
No device-level teardown concurrency (one device per process).
